title: Transmission Control System Malfunction
shortDescription: Generic transmission control system fault — informational MIL trigger.
fullDescription: DTC P0700: Generic transmission control system fault — informational MIL trigger. Indicates a fault in the transmission control system, manual gearbox sensors, or transfer case interface. Diagnosis requires reading TCM data alongside engine codes.
safetyImpact: Transmission may shift harshly, hold a gear, or enter limp mode. Drive cautiously and avoid towing until repaired.

causes.cause: Damaged wiring or connector at TCM/transmission
Worn clutch pack or torque converter

symptoms: Check engine and/or transmission warning lamp
Stuck in a single gear (limp mode)

fixSteps.title: Scan Transmission Module
fixSteps.instruction: Read TCM codes, freeze frame, and live data including gear ratio, line pressure, and shift solenoid commands.

fixSteps.title: Check Fluid and Linkage
fixSteps.instruction: Verify ATF level/condition (or gear oil for manual), shift linkage adjustment, and clutch hydraulics.

fixSteps.title: Test Solenoids / Switches
fixSteps.instruction: Measure solenoid resistance and switch continuity. Compare to spec; replace any out of range.

fixSteps.title: Repair or Rebuild
fixSteps.instruction: Replace faulty components, transfer case actuator, or reseal/rebuild transmission as indicated.

faq.q: Is it safe to drive with a transmission code?
faq.a: Limp mode is intended to get you home or to a shop. Avoid extended driving, hills, and any towing.

faq.q: Will fluid service fix this?
faq.a: Sometimes — a fluid and filter service resolves shift quality issues caused by old fluid, but electrical and mechanical faults need targeted repair.

faq.q: Can I reset the code and keep driving?
faq.a: Codes will return if the underlying fault remains. Fix the root cause to avoid further internal damage.

title: Upshift Switch Circuit
fullDescription: DTC P0815: Upshift paddle / switch circuit fault. Indicates a fault in the transmission control system, manual gearbox sensors, or transfer case interface. Diagnosis requires reading TCM data alongside engine codes.
safetyImpact: Transmission may shift harshly, hold a gear, or enter limp mode. Drive cautiously and avoid towing until repaired.

causes.cause: Damaged wiring or connector at TCM/transmission
Worn clutch pack or torque converter

symptoms: Check engine and/or transmission warning lamp
Stuck in a single gear (limp mode)

fixSteps.title: Scan Transmission Module
fixSteps.instruction: Read TCM codes, freeze frame, and live data including gear ratio, line pressure, and shift solenoid commands.

fixSteps.title: Check Fluid and Linkage
fixSteps.instruction: Verify ATF level/condition (or gear oil for manual), shift linkage adjustment, and clutch hydraulics.

fixSteps.title: Test Solenoids / Switches
fixSteps.instruction: Measure solenoid resistance and switch continuity. Compare to spec; replace any out of range.

fixSteps.title: Repair or Rebuild
fixSteps.instruction: Replace faulty components, transfer case actuator, or reseal/rebuild transmission as indicated.
